stories.title: Italia-Belgio, azzurri sconfitti in casa 2-0 allo stadio Olimpico, disfatta Mancini

en.title: Italy-Belgium, Italians defeated at home 2-0 at the Olympic Stadium, Mancini debacle
en.summary: Italy lost to Belgium 2-0 at home under new coach Mancini. The team was dominated and conceded goals, drawing whistles from the crowd.

stories.title: 'Trump ha respinto la proposta dell'Iran, nuovi attacchi dopo le midterm'

en.title: Trump rejected Iran's proposal, new attacks after the midterms
en.summary: According to the Wall Street Journal, the United States rejected Iran's plan to end hostilities. Additional attacks are expected following the midterm elections.

stories.title: Accise, si dimezza lo sconto. Eni si muove sui carburanti, tetto ai prezzi per un mese

en.title: Excise duties, discount cut in half. Eni moves on fuel prices, price ceiling for one month
en.summary: The government reduced the excise duty discount on fuel. Eni implemented price controls, with diesel potentially reaching 2.4 euros, while opposition and transport groups criticized the lack of energy policy.

stories.title: Guerra in Iran, news di oggi. Wsj: “No di Trump all'accordo, nuovi attacchi dopo le elezioni di midterm”

en.title: War in Iran, today's news. WSJ: Trump's no to the agreement, new attacks after midterm elections
en.summary: Iran's foreign minister proposed reopening the Strait of Hormuz within seven days, but the U.S. president rejected the agreement, with further attacks anticipated following the midterm elections.

stories.title: Nations League. Lukaku provoca Donnarumma: tensione nel finale di Italia-Belgio

en.title: Nations League. Lukaku provokes Donnarumma: tension in the closing stages of Italy-Belgium
en.summary: A negative incident occurred late in the Italy-Belgium Nations League match involving former Inter and Napoli player Lukaku and Italian goalkeeper Donnarumma.

stories.title: Mancini non perde la fiducia: “Bravi nel secondo tempo”. Di Lorenzo: “Ingiusto massacrarci subito”

en.title: Mancini keeps faith: "Good in the second half". Di Lorenzo: "Unfair to massacre us immediately"
en.summary: Italy's manager expressed satisfaction with the team's second-half performance while a player defended the squad against criticism following negative crowd reaction.

stories.title: Italia-Belgio, le pagelle azzurre: Romano sbaglia, Esposito timido. Tonali triste

en.title: Italy-Belgium, Italian player ratings: Romano makes mistakes, Esposito timid. Tonali sad
en.summary: A Nations League match played at the Olimpico stadium featured mixed individual performances among Italian players with varying assessments of their display.

stories.title: Il ct Mancini: primo tempo sotto le aspettative, ma nel secondo tempo abbiamo fatto bene

en.title: Coach Mancini: first half below expectations, but we played well in the second half
en.summary: Italy's manager acknowledged a poor first-half performance while crediting an improved second-half display, commenting that crowd disapproval is normal when losing.

stories.title: Nations League: l'Italia parte male, il Belgio vince 2-0

en.title: Nations League: Italy starts poorly, Belgium wins 2-0
en.summary: Belgium defeated Italy 2-0 with goals from Godts and Lukebakio in a Nations League match, putting Italy in a difficult position early in the competition.

stories.title: Nations League. Romano sbaglia il disimpegno, il Belgio riparte e segna con Godts

en.title: Nations League. Romano makes a clearance mistake, Belgium restarts and scores with Godts
en.summary: Italy struggled against Belgium in a Nations League match, with the Belgian team controlling play and capitalizing on Italian errors to score.

stories.title: L’Italia del Mancini bis parte male: il Belgio vince a Roma 2-0, l’Olimpico fischia gli Azzurri

en.title: Mancini's second spell gets off to a poor start: Belgium wins 2-0 in Rome, the Olimpico boos the Azzurri
en.summary: Italy delivered a poor performance in their first match under new coach Mancini, losing 2-0 to Belgium at home. The team faces Turkey on Monday.

stories.title: Caro-carburanti, Eni mette il tetto al prezzo: da lunedì benzina a 1,99 euro e gasolio a 2,19 per un mese

en.title: Fuel prices, Eni sets price cap: from Monday gasoline at 1.99 euros and diesel at 2.19 for one month
en.summary: Eni imposed a price ceiling on fuel starting September 28, aligned with existing tax relief on excise duties, offering drivers savings of 10 to 11 euros per tank fill.

stories.title: Fondi UE, il rischio di fare bene le cose sbagliate: la riforma che cambia le regole di valutazione dal 2028

en.title: EU Funds, the risk of doing well the wrong things: the reform that changes evaluation rules from 2028
en.summary: European Union fund evaluation methods are being reformed, changing how results are measured, counted, and verified starting in 2028. The reform is among several policy matters under discussion in Brussels for the upcoming budget cycle.

stories.title: Grimaldi: «Investiremo 3 miliardi sulle navi del futuro»

en.title: Grimaldi: "We will invest 3 billion on ships of the future"
en.summary: Grimaldi announces a 3 billion investment in future ship development. The company reports solid results in 2025 despite a challenging economic environment.

stories.title: In Calabria, Sardegna e Sicilia i primi treni a idrogeno a scartamento ridotto al mondo

en.title: In Calabria, Sardinia and Sicily the world's first narrow-gauge hydrogen trains
en.summary: Swiss company Stadler has manufactured 21 hydrogen-powered trains for three Italian regional operators: 10 for Sardinian regional transport, 9 for Calabrian railways, and 2 for Sicilian Circumetnea railway.

stories.title: Sui costruttori la scure degli extra-costi

en.title: Construction companies face the burden of extra costs
en.summary: Construction industry representatives report that material costs including concrete, plastic, bitumen, and electrical cables continue rising, eroding profits and reducing available liquidity.

stories.title: All’Ospedale di Niguarda una “Casa” per le famiglie dei bimbi in pediatria

en.title: A "House" for families of children in pediatrics at Niguarda Hospital
en.summary: A new 600-square-meter facility was inaugurated in the pediatrics department at Niguarda Hospital in Milan, expanding Casa Ronald McDonald Italia Ets' presence within the hospital.
